observations.statement: enroll() still records a rejected enrollment but no longer calls notifications.notify() for it, so a student turned away from a full course gets no enrollment-rejected notification. The approved rule rul-announce-every-decision says every decision, confirmed or rejected, results in exactly one notification; crt-rejection-notified requires it. Proposed resolution: restore the rejection notification in enroll().

tests.name: EnrollmentService > rejects an enrollment into a full course and notifies the student
Course Desk API (e2e) > confirms, then rejects when full; each student is notified of their outcome
